current_direction.title: CASPIAN — THE DAY THE SILENCE SANG
current_direction.story_thesis: There are worlds that only open when Caspian arrives. Ordinary reality reveals hidden wonder, memory and impossible worlds, then returns to the birthday room with wonder intact.
current_direction.motion_translation: Living-image metamorph: stable composition, internal motion first, identity anchors, progressive localized material replacement, coherent transformation states, restrained camera.
current_direction.visual_material: Natural-world matter, photographic/emulsion textures, bark, water, stars, smoke, brass-gold fissures and light. Do not copy the reference clip's exact black sculptural material.
current_direction.door_rule: A door/threshold is a narrative mechanism, never the dominant repeated image. Any ordinary surface may become a threshold.
current_direction.character_rule: Caspian is the recurring protagonist; preserve one consistent child identity across generated story media.
current_direction.preview_policy: Image previews are enabled when the generation runtime surfaces them. Keeping chat light never authorizes procedural placeholder substitution.

production_asset_gate.rule: Do not advance to SHOT_PACKAGES_BUILT until actual generated story assets exist in ASSET_MANIFEST.json and each shot package has hashed media_evidence.
